description: BEP - liste des recyparcs is a group of related datasets listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by BEP. Ceci est la liste des recyparcs gérés par le BEP. Pour les camions de collecte, il faut se rendre sur le site internet du BEP: www.bep-environnement.be The 2 datasets in this record: BEP - Liste des recyparcs; Liste des recyparcs. Coverage: Province of Namur (Wallonia). The portal lists 2 related datasets of one publisher (copies, years or sister lists), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under Agriculture, Environnement. Its keywords are Environnement, Recyparcs, BEP, Recyclage, Déchet, Conteneur. The portal shows 33 records. The portal shows 2026-07-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support waste collection, treatment and recycling network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
